about.en: SK Hynix (Ondo Tokenized) (SKHYon) is an Ondo tokenized stock issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform, giving eligible non-US holders economic exposure to the US-listed SK hynix shares (SKHY). It is fully backed by the underlying security and is a total return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so its price can drift above the underlying's. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xc0fe36f4ffbdf1b38e192215073590a68f9a2af7, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights.
